description: Source code for Mattermost server's integration action handling, including processing post actions, dialogs, and plugin requests.

methods.name: DoPostActionWithCookie
methods.description: Handles post actions with optional cookie data, sends requests to integrations, updates posts, and manages ephemeral messages.

methods.name: DoActionRequest
methods.description: Performs HTTP POST requests to internal or external integration endpoints, routing requests appropriately.

methods.name: doPluginRequest
methods.description: Executes plugin requests, routing to plugin server HTTP handler.

methods.name: OpenInteractiveDialog
methods.description: Opens an interactive dialog by sending a WebSocket event after decoding and verifying trigger ID.

methods.name: SubmitInteractiveDialog
methods.description: Submits dialog responses to external or internal endpoints, handling response validation and size limits.

methods.name: LookupInteractiveDialog
methods.description: Performs dialog lookup requests, handling response decoding and size limits.
